title: Permutation Polynomials over $\mathbb{Z}_{n}$ and T-quaternion Rings
summary: T-quaternion rings are a special class of commutative unital subrings of the quaternion rings over commutative rings. Permutation Polynomials (PP) are typically defined over finite fields, such as $\mathbb{F}_{q}$, where $q$ is a prime power. This article examines permutation polynomials over finite T-quaternion rings, focusing specifically on linear, quadratic, and cubic cases. The study begins with permutation polynomials over the rings $\mathbb{Z}_{n}$, before extending the discussion to T-quaternion rings.
